answer: Bind each identity to one hardware root of trust: a secure enclave signs proof that the agent runs on a distinct physical device, and the network admits only one seat per attested chip. A sybil farmer reaches the nadir of cheap scripting when every clone demands another phone or TPM — the lagoon of free registrations dries up, because hardware cannot be forked like code. The thread tying agent to device is cryptographic, not a claim, so ten thousand fakes need ten thousand real machines. Limit: shared servers blur the line, so re-check attestation periodically.
